input.idea: I Built a Self-Sustaining City That Can Survive a World Reset, But I Can't Use Any External Resources

reasoning: The idea has a clear premise (building a self-sustaining city), a unique constraint (no external resources), and a compelling question (will it survive a reset?). It offers progression through construction phases, escalating challenges, and a dramatic payoff. It avoids formulaic templates and provides strong visual potential for building and destruction. The only minor issue is execution difficulty, but it's still feasible for a dedicated creator.
improved_version: I Built a Self-Sustaining City That Can Survive a World Reset, But I Can't Use Any External Resources or Redstone
improvement_reasoning: Adding the redstone restriction increases the challenge and forces more creative solutions, enhancing originality and difficulty. This creates a stronger sense of constraint and makes the video more distinct from other survival builds. The improved version maintains the core premise but adds an extra layer of mechanical limitation that increases both story tension and visual interest.
